2610.11167.title: PIVOT: Perplexity-Informed KD-to-RL Transition Scheduling for Vertical-Domain Few-Shot Distillation
2610.11167.paper_summary: Vertical-domain few-shot classification remains challenging for small language models, as limited supervision makes it difficult to acquire domain-specific decision knowledge. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) can improve teacher-guided adaptation by supervising student-generated rollouts, while GRPO-based reinforcement learning can further refine downstream predictions. However, existing KD-to-RL pipelines typically rely on globally fixed transition schedules, ignoring that different samples may require different amounts of teacher-guided acquisition before reward-driven refinement. We propose PIVOT (Perplexity-Informed Transition Optimization), a dynamic transition framework that routes samples between OPD and GRPO according to teacher-evaluated sequence perplexity. PIVOT moves low-perplexity samples to GRPO for reward-driven refinement while keeping high-perplexity samples under OPD for continued domain knowledge acquisition. Experiments on Banking77 and HWU64 show that PIVOT consistently outperforms continued OPD and globally synchronized OPD$\rightarrow$GRPO baselines under the same number of post-warm-up student optimization steps, achieving stronger downstream performance and more stable training dynamics.
2610.11167.paper_summary_zh: 垂直領域的少量樣本分類對於小型語言模型仍然具有挑戰性，因為有限的監督使得獲取特定領域的決策知識變得困難。基於策略的蒸餾（On-Policy Distillation, OPD）可以通過監督學生生成的展開來改善教師引導的適應，而基於GRPO的強化學習則可以進一步精煉下游預測。然而，現有的KD到RL管道通常依賴於全局固定的轉換計劃，忽視了不同樣本可能需要不同量的教師引導獲取才能進行獎勵驅動的精煉。我們提出了PIVOT（困惑度信息轉換優化），這是一個動態轉換框架，根據教師評估的序列困惑度在OPD和GRPO之間路由樣本。PIVOT將低困惑度樣本轉移到GRPO進行獎勵驅動的精煉，同時將高困惑度樣本保持在OPD下以持續獲取領域知識。在Banking77和HWU64上的實驗顯示，PIVOT在相同的後熱身學生優化步數下，始終超越持續的OPD和全局同步的OPD$\rightarrow$GRPO基線，實現了更強的下游性能和更穩定的訓練動態。
